title: Uwell Viscore Neo 6K Prefilled Pod & Refill Blueberry Sour Raspberry
description: This convenient Blueberry Sour Raspberry 6K Prefilled Pod & Refill Pack for the Uwell Viscore Neo Prefilled Pod Kit pairs a 2ml prefilled pod with a 4ml auto-refill container to deliver a combined 6ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid. Designed for longevity and ease of use, the smart refill structure automatically feeds e-liquid to the coil, providing up to 6000 puffs* before needing a replacement. Blueberry Sour Raspberry is a balanced fruit profile contrasting sweet, mellow Blueberry with a sharp, tangy Sour Raspberry finish. The deep, jammy berry base is perfectly lifted by the bright, tart notes, creating a dynamic and continuously satisfying vape experience. Inside the 2ml pod is an integrated 0.8ohm mesh coil, engineered to provide rapid, even heating for consistently dense vapour and highly accurate flavour reproduction. Fully compatible with the Viscore Neo battery device, this pack offers a reliable Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) vape that is simple to set up and effortless to maintain. How to Set Up Your Uwell Viscore Neo Pod: 1. Remove the 4ml refill container from the top of the packaging. 2. Remove the red silicone plug located on the top of the 2ml prefilled pod. 3. Insert the 4ml refill container into the 2ml prefilled pod smoothly until it is assembled in place. 4. Insert the fully assembled unit into your device. Note: We recommend waiting exactly five minutes after assembly to allow the e-liquid to fully saturate the mesh coil before taking your first draw. *Puff counts are approximate and dependent on the length of each draw. Total puffs may vary.
